faq.title: Everything you need to know about the beta.

items.q: Where does the data come from?
items.a: Exclusively from public and official sources: company registries, BODACC, public tenders (BOAMP, DECP), job postings, press and institutional websites. No data is ever made up: if a piece of information isn't found, it doesn't appear.
Yes. Data is hosted in Europe and covers only professional B2B information. We provide a DPA, and you keep control of your data (export, deletion) at any time.

Yes. BellumAI integrates with HubSpot and Salesforce to export your contacts and briefs. You switch the connection on from Settings › Integrations, using your own tool account. You stay in control of what is synced, in which direction and to which CRM.

items.q: Does BellumAI act on LinkedIn for me?
items.a: No. We prepare your messages and contacts and let you export them — but we don't automate any action on LinkedIn. No scraping or automated sending that would breach the terms of service: you keep control of your accounts.
Each workspace is isolated, access is encrypted and partitioned per user, and integration tokens (CRM) are encrypted at rest. Data access is restricted and logged.

items.q: How do credits work during the beta?
items.a: Credits are included in the 59 €/month. A full account analysis costs 8 of them, a refresh 4 and a contact enrichment 1; the copilot, messages and exports cost none. The price is shown before the click, and nothing is charged when nothing is found.
A flexible 1-to-2-month commitment, with no automatic renewal. In exchange for the beta price, we ask for regular usage feedback and two to three short calls of about 20 minutes.
You move freely to a standard plan, with a preferential price reserved for beta IT services firms. No obligation to continue: if the product brings you nothing, you stop at no cost.
